title: A lower bound on the density of prefixes with maximal palindromic length
summary: The palindromic length $PL(u)$ of a nonempty finite word $u$ is the least number of nonempty palindromes whose concatenation is $u$. For an infinite word $w$, let $P_w(n)$ be the number of nonempty palindromic prefixes of $w[1,n]$, and let $T_w(n)$ consist of those prefixes $w[1,j]$, $1\leq j\leq n$, whose palindromic length equals the maximum attained among the nonempty prefixes of $w[1,j]$. We prove the finite inequality $|T_w(n)|\geq P_w(n)$ for every $n\geq1$.
